checks.label: Puzzle 1: any three of the four pieces is 3/4 of the bar; none, two or all four is not
Puzzle 2: the wide piece alone is half the square, and so are the two small ones together; one small piece, or the wide one with a small one, is not
Puzzles 3 and 6: 3/4 is the third quarter tick, three quarters of the way from 0 to 1; 7/4 is the seventh, three ticks past 1
Puzzle 4: 5/8 is less than 3/4 (0.625 against 0.75), so five of eight pieces fill less of the same bar than three of four
Puzzle 5: seven quarters fill one bar of four and three pieces of the next, so 7/4 is 1 3/4; four or eight pieces is not 7/4
